title: Rockstar Approached Netflix for GTA 6 Extended Look
description: According to IGN Games, it was actually Rockstar Games that initiated the collaboration with Netflix for the GTA 6 extended look.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Behind the GTA 6 Extended Look: Rockstar Made the First Move

Every piece of news regarding *Grand Theft Auto VI* (GTA6) sends shockwaves through the gaming community. Recently, fascinating behind-the-scenes details regarding the much-discussed GTA6 extended look have emerged. According to a report by gaming media outlet IGN Games, the collaboration between the massive gaming franchise and streaming giant Netflix was actually initiated by Rockstar Games, rather than the other way around.

### A Proactive Approach to Marketing

In typical industry partnerships, streaming platforms are usually the ones chasing top-tier gaming intellectual properties to boost their own engagement. However, this situation flipped the standard script. IGN Games reported that it was Rockstar Games that approached Netflix to bring the grand GTA6 extended look to the platform, setting a unique precedent for cross-industry promotion.

Looking back at the release, the major GTA6 extended look (mostly) went off without a hitch, captivating millions of fans worldwide. While audiences thoroughly enjoyed the fresh footage, knowing that Rockstar itself spearheaded the outreach highlights the developer's meticulous control over its promotional campaign.

### Expanding Beyond Traditional Gaming

By partnering with a global entertainment titan like Netflix, Rockstar managed to place its crown-jewel IP in front of a massive mainstream audience outside of traditional gaming channels. This proactive strategy demonstrates Rockstar's immense market confidence and its ability to dictate the terms of how and where its game is showcased to the world.

## Editor's Take
Rockstar initiating the contact with Netflix for the GTA6 extended look shows just how much control the studio maintains over its monumental marketing campaign. It is a bold, calculated move that highlights their confidence in the game's universal appeal, proving once again that Rockstar plays by its own rules in the industry.
